doc.brief: Describes hints that might be taken into account by input methods or applications.
doc.md:
Describes hints that might be taken into account by input methods
or applications.

Note that input methods may already tailor their behaviour according
to the [`InputPurpose`](xref:gtk:InputPurpose) of the entry.

Some common sense is expected when using these flags - mixing
%GTK_INPUT_HINT_LOWERCASE with any of the uppercase hints makes no sense.

This enumeration may be extended in the future; input methods should
ignore unknown values.

inhibit_osk.brief: Suggest to not show an onscreen keyboard (e.g for a calculator that already has all the keys).
